name: The Millen Penang, Autograph Collection
short_description: A 146-room design-led hotel on George Town's 'Millionaire's Row', Penang's first Autograph Collection property, mixing colonial British-Malaya style with contemporary art, an infinity pool and three restaurants.
ai_summary: The Millen Penang is the island's first Autograph Collection hotel, a 146-room high-rise on Northam Road ('Millionaire's Row') that reworks Penang's old-money heritage through a contemporary, art-led lens. It quietly opened to guests on 3 February 2025 and held its official grand opening on 30 September 2025, so it is a genuinely new property with a still-limited but strongly positive review base across TripAdvisor and editorial coverage. Reviewers and early guests consistently praise the spacious, design-forward rooms (56–156 sqm), floor-to-ceiling sea or city views, marble bathrooms and freestanding bathtubs, and warm, attentive service — several note anniversary upgrades and helpful pool and front-desk staff. Independent writers describe a 'living gallery' of commissioned local artworks and a deliberately calm, 'low-touch by design' style of hospitality. Dining spans Lili (modern Malaysian), Good Society (British-style tea salon and bar) and Blacklinen (charcoal-grilled aged meats and seafood), plus a Level 9 saltwater infinity pool and Nut&Meg wellness spa. Watch-outs are those of a design hotel rather than a beach resort: it sits on the edge of Gurney Drive rather than inside the heritage core, some guests find dining pricey or breakfast choice limited, and occasional service-efficiency lapses appear as the team beds in. Overall it reads as a polished, well-run debut aimed at design-conscious travellers.

146 rooms and suites, with Sterling/Silver two-bedroom suites at ~156 sqm among Penang's largest

faqs.question: When did The Millen Penang open?
faqs.answer: It welcomed its first guests on 3 February 2025 and held its official grand opening on 30 September 2025. It is a full redevelopment of the former Northam All Suite Hotel on Northam Road.

faqs.question: How far is The Millen Penang from Penang International Airport?
faqs.answer: About 17 km, roughly a 35-minute drive depending on traffic. The hotel sits on Jalan Sultan Ahmad Shah (Northam Road), near Gurney Drive in George Town.

faqs.question: What dining and facilities does The Millen offer?
faqs.answer: Three venues — Lili (modern Malaysian), Good Society (British-style tea salon and bar) and Blacklinen (charcoal grill) — plus a Level 9 saltwater infinity pool, 24-hour fitness centre and the Nut&Meg wellness spa.

reviews.title: Trading Hustle for Horizon at The Millen Penang, A Review
reviews.author: Bryan Yap
reviews.summary: Frames The Millen as a mansion for the contemporary elite. Praises a 56 sqm room with floor-to-ceiling Straits views and a freestanding tub, plus three dining venues, pool and spa. Best for design-lovers valuing calm over location.

reviews.title: The Millen Penang on Millionaire's Row
reviews.author: Florence Ang
reviews.summary: Editorial review of the 146-room Autograph Collection with a Peranakan fountain by Pamela Tan. Notes colonial-contemporary marble interiors, a saltwater infinity pool, spa and three restaurants. An experiential, design-forward stay.

reviews.title: The Millen, Penang's latest and chicest hotel
reviews.author: Keandra H'ng
reviews.summary: Feature on Penang first Autograph Collection, blending colonial elegance with local culture. Notes 146 rooms with marble baths, Nespresso and nutmeg toiletries, three dining venues, a saltwater infinity pool and a gallery of local art.
